Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the follow up and the questionnaire. Quick note from procurement/legal: they need the vendor attestation and a completed intake form in our portal before we can do a live exec/demo. Our SSO team also needs to provision a test Okta client (we require SAML metadata exchange) which typically takes 10 business days once the intake is completed.

We have two blockers right now: internal legal needs to countersign the NDA (I've started the DocuSign flow) and procurement has queued the intake for review (procurement@lane-fin.com is CC'd). Given that timeline, the earliest we can have the formal demo is the week of Oct 4.

That said, our lead infra engineer (Samir) would definitely benefit from a technical call to review architecture and integration points sooner — would your solutions engineer be available for a 30-min tech sync next Wed (Sep 22)?
